Alabama.redemption_period: 3 years from date of tax sale
Alabama.foreclosure_process: Judicial foreclosure after 3-year redemption window expiration
Alabama.bidding_method: Bid down interest rate (lowest interest wins, starting at 12%)

Alaska.bidding_method: Premium bid over delinquent taxes and costs

Arizona.foreclosure_process: Judicial foreclosure of right to redeem in Superior Court

Arkansas.foreclosure_process: Certified to State Commissioner of State Lands (COSL)

Connecticut.foreclosure_process: Summary tax collector deed or judicial tax foreclosure

Delaware.foreclosure_process: Superior Court monition proceeding and sheriff execution

Georgia.auction_type: Sheriff Tax Deed Sale (First Tuesday of Month)

Hawaii.foreclosure_process: County director of finance public auction

Idaho.statutory_interest_rate: 1% per month penalty plus statutory fees
Idaho.foreclosure_process: County Commissioners issue deed to county, then auction

Illinois.statutory_interest_rate: Up to 18% penalty per 6-month period (bid down to 0%)

Indiana.auction_type: County Treasurer Tax Sale (Fall) & Commissioner Certificate Sale (Spring)

Indiana.foreclosure_process: Petition to Circuit Court for Tax Deed

Iowa.auction_type: Annual County Tax Sale (Third Monday in June)
Iowa.redemption_period: 1 year 9 months before 90-day Notice of Right of Redemption
Iowa.foreclosure_process: County Treasurer Tax Deed issued after 90-day notice expiry
Iowa.bidding_method: Bid down undivided percentage interest (down to 1%)

Kansas.statutory_interest_rate: Statutory interest rate set by state director of taxation
Kansas.redemption_period: 2 years (vacant) to 3 years (homestead) before foreclosure petition
Kansas.foreclosure_process: District Court foreclosure action followed by Sheriff auction
Kansas.bidding_method: Competitive public auction; immediate title transfer

Kentucky.auction_type: County Clerk Delinquent Tax Bill Sale (Summer)

Kentucky.redemption_period: 1 year from certificate of delinquency purchase
Kentucky.foreclosure_process: Judicial foreclosure in Circuit Court after 1-year holding
Kentucky.bidding_method: Registered third-party purchasers buy certificates at par

Louisiana.statutory_interest_rate: 1% per month penalty (12% per year) plus 5% flat statutory fee
Louisiana.redemption_period: 3 years from recordation of tax sale
Louisiana.foreclosure_process: Suit to Quiet Title / Monition proceeding
Louisiana.bidding_method: Bid down least undivided percentage of property (CivicSource)

Maryland.statutory_interest_rate: Set by county statute (typically 6% to 24% per year)
Maryland.foreclosure_process: Circuit Court Equity Proceeding to foreclose right of redemption

Massachusetts.statutory_interest_rate: 16% per annum on tax title account
Massachusetts.redemption_period: 6 months after taking before Land Court petition
Massachusetts.foreclosure_process: Land Court Petition to foreclose all rights of redemption

Michigan.bidding_method: Online auction via Title-Check / County portal

Minnesota.statutory_interest_rate: Statutory interest rate set by state
Minnesota.redemption_period: 3 years (non-agricultural) / 5 years (homestead) from tax judgment sale

Mississippi.auction_type: County Tax Sale (Last Monday in August)
Mississippi.foreclosure_process: Chancery Clerk issues Tax Deed after 2-year statutory notice
Mississippi.bidding_method: Overbid auction at courthouse or online (GovEase)

Missouri.auction_type: County Collector Delinquent Land Tax Sale (Fourth Monday in August)
Missouri.redemption_period: 1 year for 1st & 2nd offerings; no redemption on 3rd offering
Missouri.foreclosure_process: Collector issues deed after 90-day title search notice

Montana.auction_type: County Treasurer Tax Lien Sale (Annual July)
Montana.redemption_period: 3 years from tax lien assignment date
Montana.foreclosure_process: County Treasurer Tax Deed application with 60-day notice

Nebraska.auction_type: County Treasurer Tax Sale (First Monday in March)
Nebraska.foreclosure_process: District Court foreclosure or administrative Treasurer's deed

Nevada.auction_type: County Treasurer Tax Delinquent Property Auction

Nevada.redemption_period: 2 years from first Monday in June following delinquency
Nevada.foreclosure_process: Treasurer conveys deed to County in trust, auctioned after notice

New Hampshire.redemption_period: 2 years from tax lien execution date
New Hampshire.foreclosure_process: Tax Collector Deed to Town/City after 2-year redemption expiry

New Jersey.statutory_interest_rate: Up to 18% per annum (bid down to 0% with cash premium)
New Jersey.redemption_period: 2 years from sale date (private buyer) / 6 months (municipality)
New Jersey.foreclosure_process: Superior Court in rem or in personam Tax Lien Foreclosure
New Jersey.bidding_method: Bid down interest rate; bid up cash premium at 0%

New Mexico.auction_type: State Taxation and Revenue Department Delinquent Property Sale
New Mexico.redemption_period: 3 years from delinquency before transfer to state for auction
New Mexico.foreclosure_process: Property Tax Division of State auctions property

New York.auction_type: In Rem Tax Foreclosure Auction (NYS Real Property Tax Law)
New York.redemption_period: 2 years from date of tax lien filing
New York.foreclosure_process: County County Court in rem foreclosure proceeding
New York.bidding_method: County public surplus auction (NYSauctions / Auctions International)

North Carolina.auction_type: County Sheriff / Commissioner Tax Foreclosure Auction
North Carolina.redemption_period: 10-day upset bid period following the auction
North Carolina.foreclosure_process: Judicial foreclosure proceeding in Superior Court
North Carolina.bidding_method: Courthouse auction with 10-day upset bid process (minimum 5% increase)

North Dakota.auction_type: Annual County Tax Foreclosure Auction (Third Tuesday in November)
North Dakota.redemption_period: 3 years from date of tax lien attachment
North Dakota.foreclosure_process: County Auditor Tax Deed issued after 90-day certified notice
North Dakota.bidding_method: Public oral auction at county courthouse

Ohio.redemption_period: 1 year statutory redemption period for tax certificates; right to redeem prior to confirmation of sale
Ohio.foreclosure_process: County Prosecutor files tax foreclosure in Common Pleas Court; Sheriff conducts auction (RealAuction/Online)

Oklahoma.redemption_period: 2 years from initial November tax sale
Oklahoma.foreclosure_process: Treasurer Resale Deed conveys virgin fee-simple title extinguishing prior liens

Oregon.redemption_period: 2 years from date of circuit court foreclosure judgment
Oregon.foreclosure_process: Circuit Court general judgment followed by County Tax Deed

Pennsylvania.foreclosure_process: Upset Sale (subject to mortgages); Judicial Sale (free and clear title)

Rhode Island.statutory_interest_rate: 1% per month penalty + 10% redemption penalty in year 1
Rhode Island.redemption_period: 1 year from sale date before Superior Court petition
Rhode Island.foreclosure_process: Petition to Foreclose Right of Redemption in Superior Court

South Carolina.statutory_interest_rate: 3% in Q1, 6% in Q2, 9% in Q3, 12% in Q4 (capped at bid amount)
South Carolina.redemption_period: 12 months from date of tax sale
South Carolina.foreclosure_process: Tax Collector issues Delinquent Tax Deed after 12-month notice

South Dakota.auction_type: County Treasurer Tax Certificate Sale (Third Monday in December)
South Dakota.redemption_period: 3 years (or 4 years if municipal) from sale date
South Dakota.foreclosure_process: Treasurer Tax Deed proceedings with 60-day notice of intention
South Dakota.bidding_method: Private or public tax certificate assignment

Tennessee.statutory_interest_rate: 12% per annum statutory interest on redemption
Tennessee.redemption_period: 1 year from entry of confirmation of sale order

Virginia.redemption_period: Right of redemption terminates upon entry of decree of confirmation
Virginia.foreclosure_process: Circuit Court equity suit for sale of land for delinquent taxes
Virginia.bidding_method: Public auction conducted by Special Commissioner

Washington.auction_type: County Treasurer Tax Foreclosure Auction (Annual Fall/Winter)

Washington.redemption_period: 3 years from delinquency before certificate of delinquency issued; right to redeem ends day before sale

West Virginia.auction_type: Sheriff Tax Lien Sale (November) & State Auditor Escrow Sale
West Virginia.statutory_interest_rate: 12% per annum statutory interest on redemption
West Virginia.foreclosure_process: State Auditor Deputy Commissioner deed issuance following title examination
West Virginia.bidding_method: Sheriff auction followed by State Auditor public land sale

Wisconsin.statutory_interest_rate: 1% per month penalty + 0.5% county penalty (18% total)

Wisconsin.bidding_method: County surplus real estate public sale

Wyoming.auction_type: County Treasurer Tax Lien Sale (July / August)
Wyoming.foreclosure_process: Treasurer Tax Deed application with 3-month statutory notice
Wyoming.bidding_method: County lottery / round-robin selection at par value
